stem.text: A spring of unstretched length $0.10\,\text{m}$ is suspended vertically from a support.
A weight of $2.0\,\text{N}$ is attached to the bottom of the spring and its length increases to $0.15\,\text{m}$.
An additional weight of $4.0\,\text{N}$ is then added to the bottom of the spring.
How much extra elastic potential energy is stored in the spring due to the addition of the $4.0\,\text{N}$ weight?
